component_height: height of the component in inches
component_width: width of the component in inches
stile_left_side_door: indicates whether there is a door on the stile's left side when viewed from the room
stile_left_side_hinging: indicates whether the left side of the stile serves as the hinge stile for the adjacent door, rather than the keep stile
stile_left_side_door_height: height of the door on the left side of the stile
stile_left_side_door_floor_clearance: floor clearance of the door on the left side of the stile
stile_left_side_door_ceiling_clearance: ceiling clearance of the door on the left side of the stile
stile_left_side_door_swinging_out: indicates whether the door on the left side of the stile swings outward into the bathroom
stile_right_side_door: indicates whether there is a door on the stile's right side when viewed from the room
stile_right_side_hinging: indicates whether the right side of the stile serves as the hinge stile for the adjacent door, rather than the keep stile
stile_right_side_door_height: height of the door on the right side of the stile
stile_right_side_door_floor_clearance: floor clearance of the door on the right side of the stile
stile_right_side_door_ceiling_clearance: ceiling clearance of the door on the right side of the stile
stile_right_side_door_swinging_out: indicates whether the door on the right side of the stile swings outward into the bathroom
